research.title: Non-determinism in LLM inference
research.organization: UT Dallas · Undergraduate Research Assistant, URAP
research.summary: Investigating why the same model produces different results across inference-serving stacks, kernel implementations, and hardware backends.
bullets: Curated 200+ documented root causes from issues, commits, and pull requests across open-source ML and inference repositories.
Developed a taxonomy covering floating-point reduction order, kernel selection, batching and scheduling, and sampling and seed handling.
Built Python harnesses that isolate and replay divergent inference runs.

research.title: Astronomical anomaly detection
research.summary: Used generative models to augment astronomical image datasets and improve detection of rare celestial events.
bullets: Trained a DCGAN in PyTorch, reaching 0.85 ROC-AUC and 0.72 recall on Galaxy10.
Fine-tuned StyleGAN to reach 0.81 ROC-AUC on rare celestial events.
Improved rare-event detection performance by 15% over baseline with GAN-based data augmentation.

research.title: Resource allocation at the edge
research.summary: Studied how to place scientific workflows across volunteer edge nodes with different compute and storage resources.
bullets: Reached 84% workflow-placement accuracy using K-Means clustering over CPU, RAM, and storage telemetry.
Built a repeatable Docker and AWS EC2 testbed with multiple Linux VMs, using the Elbow Method to tune cluster size.

projects.title: Holler
projects.summary: A persistent agent runtime for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Twilio voice, with Gmail, Outlook, Drive, and Calendar tools.
bullets: Reached 91% task completion on a 100-workflow evaluation, with 28% fewer LLM calls and 24% lower inference cost than a multi-agent baseline.
Used single-use SQLite action records to prevent duplicate execution after a crash.
Combined semantic and lexical memory, reaching 90% Recall@5 and 92% cross-channel retrieval accuracy over 5,000+ stored interactions.
projects.stack: Python / FastAPI / TypeScript / SQLite / Twilio / Composio

projects.title: Live multiplayer poker
projects.summary: A multiplayer poker app with an authoritative WebSocket server, persistent accounts, and server-controlled chip balances.
bullets: Load-tested 360 concurrent players across 60 tables at 1,871 actions per second, with 0.3 ms p95 server action-to-broadcast latency.
Validated chip conservation and game rules across 3,000 fuzzed hands and 106 tests, including reconnects, restarts, and rate limiting.
Generated private views for each player and checked for hole-card leakage across player, spectator, and history payloads in CI.
projects.stack: React / TypeScript / Node.js / WebSockets / Supabase / Vercel

projects.title: AutoPM
projects.summary: Eight LangGraph agents run a seven-step product workflow: research, user stories, prioritization, wireframes, and Jira tickets.
bullets: Estimated to save 10+ hours of manual product work per cycle.
Connected Jira, Gmail, and Gemini through Zod-validated structured outputs, replacing 5+ manual handoffs.
Built a Next.js workspace with Auth0 sign-in and seven generated artifacts per project.

projects.title: NetGainNBA
projects.summary: NBA playoff predictions and a general-manager toolkit with bracket simulation, salary-cap tracking, and a trade engine.
bullets: Reached 88% playoff-prediction accuracy on 2020-2024 data using a seven-model ensemble across 89 features.
Built an NBA Stats API pipeline with nine player archetypes and live win-probability tracking.
Used lazy loading and Vite chunk splitting for an interface spanning 26 datasets.

projects.title: EduTube
projects.summary: A lecture companion with semantic video search and generated study materials, built with TwelveLabs and Gemini.
bullets: Processed 100+ educational videos.
Built a Fastify backend with Google Cloud Storage and webhooks for real-time video processing.
